batch_node.name: Samsite KEV fetch seed v0.2.0
batch_node.description: Seeds the static end of the CISA KEV fetch story for the samsite board: the CISA web host (cisa.gov) and the KEV catalog web document it serves, joined by HOSTS_DOCUMENT (host -> document; computing_core v0.4.0 renamed the former document -> host edge and flipped its direction, so this is seed v0.2.0 under a new batch id — an upgraded grid re-lands it rather than skipping the already-imported v0.1.0 batch). Both endpoints are seeded here, so HOSTS_DOCUMENT is safe at seed time. The dynamic end — the FETCHES_DOCUMENT edge from the deploy github_workflow to the KEV catalog — is NOT seeded here: the deploy workflow is collector-resolved (its id derives from a GitHub-assigned numeric workflow id, not knowable at authoring time), so the samsite compliance collector emits FETCHES_DOCUMENT once it resolves the signing workflow. Entity ids are uuid5 over the compliance collector's frozen namespace (node_entity_id/edge_entity_id) so the seed and the collector's FETCHES_DOCUMENT edge converge on the same kev_catalog node.

node.name: CISA
node.description: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. Publishes the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog that the samsite deploy pipeline fetches as a release-gate input.

node.name: CISA KEV Catalog
node.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — the authoritative list of CVEs known to be actively exploited. The samsite deploy pipeline fetches it each run as the KEV gate input to the VDR report (BOD 22-01).
